text: Iqra Yousaf holds account PK**HABB****7071 opened on 18 November 2020. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. Between 3 May 2026 and 28 May 2026 the account recorded 11 credits totalling PKR 16,964,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 13,902,000. There were 10 cash deposits totalling PKR 16,814,000 made at 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 28 May 2026, with a typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Nine of the ten cash deposits (90%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 15,984,000, which is just below the reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, consistent with structuring. The deposits were made across four branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), indicative of structuring. Credits in the activity window were 113.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with declared income, consistent with structuring. Taken together, the pattern of deposits just below the threshold, spread across branches, and the high cash volume relative to declared income, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 13,902,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank C) in 4 transactions. Debits equal 82% of credits and occurred with a median of 14.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 30 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
